name: scip v0.10.0
body:
Download the CLI for your current platform using:

```bash
env \
  TAG="v0.10.0" \
  OS="$(uname -s | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')" \
  ARCH="$(uname -m | sed -e 's/x86_64/amd64/')" \
  bash -c 'curl -L "https://github.com/scip-code/scip/releases/download/$TAG/scip-$OS-$ARCH.tar.gz"' \

```

* Update module github.com/hhatto/gocloc to v0.7.0 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/scip-code/scip/pull/403
* Update module zombiezen.com/go/sqlite to v1.4.2 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/scip-code/scip/pull/409
* Update dependency typescript to v6 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/scip-code/scip/pull/410
* Update module github.com/urfave/cli/v2 to v3 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/scip-code/scip/pull/416

* Migrate buf.gen.yaml from v1 to v2 syntax by @jupblb in https://github.com/scip-code/scip/pull/418
* Combine renovate fix + nix-checks into one sequenced workflow by @jupblb in https://github.com/scip-code/scip/pull/417
* Update dorny/paths-filter action to v4 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/scip-code/scip/pull/419
* Update flake.nix to 26.05 by @jupblb in https://github.com/scip-code/scip/pull/422
* Update DeterminateSystems/magic-nix-cache-action action to v14 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/scip-code/scip/pull/421
* Add Java and Kotlin protobuf bindings by @jupblb in https://github.com/scip-code/scip/pull/398
* Enable `flake.lock` updates by @jupblb in https://github.com/scip-code/scip/pull/424
* Bump version to 0.8.0 by @jupblb in https://github.com/scip-code/scip/pull/425
